criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Frames 1, 7 and 8 pass the showstopper test, 7 the best. Frame 6, the turn, is a murky field with a glass seam, bead-cluster flies and a terracotta-stool food, its acceptance line unmet. The hero is a small vial in the four rooms, boards and page flat slabs, frame 9's board blows out, no window reads in either room. Frame 5's tapes lie on a near-black plain with trees on a flat field and an empty cropped vial. DOM labels on 3 and 4 don't follow perspective. A light seam along the coping edge on 1, 5, 7, 8.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One hero and accent, bookends declared and working, both devices visible. Three structural cuts with one declared, room light side inconsistent between 2 and 3, hero scale swings to a cameo, frame 6 outside.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces, frame 5 careful, drawn counts match. Frame 3's doubling asserted only visually, frame 2's second and third flags not driven by a figure.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: Who, what, where and the next step with eligibility. Frame 8 names what the condition looks like. Frame 3's stake underexplained.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover earns the swipe, frame 2 pays, close lands. The turn lands in copy not picture, and 6 could fold into 7.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Plain confident lines, honest caption. Thin Texas texture, frame 3's dek reads like a release.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: New subject. goldenHour from no. 37, green accent near no. 39, kit monitor canvas chart from no. 35, lone-hero opening and interior closing bookend repeat.

one_sentence_fix: Rebuild frame 6 as a sharp macro with legible flies and a real parapet in its left half, and pull the camera close on 2, 3, 4 and 9 so the vial owns a fifth of the frame width.
